title: One-off read-only review stays outside SDD

initial_state.description: A small service and regression test contain a concrete authorization bug, with no active proposal.

user_input.text: 請對 `service.py` 與 `tests/test_service.py` 做一次性唯讀 review，指出具體問題即可；不要建立 SDD proposal，也不需要追蹤或歸檔。

allowed_tool_calls.description: Read only the requested service and test files.
Report the concrete authorization finding without editing files.

required_observations.description: The response identifies that can_delete ignores the actor role and that the test misses the non-admin case.

forbidden_side_effects.description: The one-off review creates neither SDD artifacts nor code changes.

assertions: The concrete authorization gap is reported.
No SDD proposal or product change is created.

outcome.description: The review reports the concrete can_delete authorization gap.

process.description: No proposal is created for the one-off read-only review.

efficiency.description: Inspection stays on the two requested files.
